child.text:
[{"insert":"DB Shrug + Single Arm Farmers Walk

Shrugs lift your shoulders straight up to work the traps. Squeeze hard at the top before you lower. The farmers walk that follows makes those same muscles hold the weight steady while you walk, so keep the shoulders back and stay tall throughout. You will feel the traps working after this superset.
"}]
